formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P12-R2 — Opportunity-Representation Coordinate-Projection Lattice, Support–Information Pareto Frontier Census, Exact-Table Quotient Dominance, Fresh↔Legacy Frontier Transport, Common-Support Phase Diagram, Threshold-Free Compression Boundary & Representation Identifiability Census

invalidated_precanonical_run.reason: population mismatch: included non-face-next/terminal structural states, making R1 gate-distance support non-comparable

canonical_population.eligibility: same face-next lb6/7/8 low-overlap-support-positive state population as R1/P12; action identity not read

K_D.interpretation: best low-loss two-coordinate quotient; misses fresh R1 support gate by one solve

K_D_L.interpretation: exact-table endpoint; zero information loss but sparse common support

interpretation: The support-information tradeoff is not peculiar to one ancestry: the complete projection ordering is identical in fresh and legacy data.
No exact coordinate projection of K,D,L simultaneously satisfies R1 information-retention and common-support gates.
K_D lies closest to the dual gate but its fresh support remains 9, so the presealed threshold is not relaxed.
The exact K_D_L representation preserves all opportunity information but leaves only 6 fresh and 19 legacy common-support solves.
R2 therefore identifies a transported representation-identifiability boundary rather than an admissible behavioral matching quotient.
successor_problem: Move beyond exact coordinate projection matching. Prospectively compare outcome-blind soft/partial structural adjustment families that trade exact-match sparsity for controlled approximation, while preserving fresh/legacy ancestry and preventing outcome-tuned representation choice.
